title: Florida House, District 71
what_it_does: Represents District 71 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Democrat Marie Masferrer was the lone Democratic candidate; Republicans Melton Little, Kristen Truong and Jordan Varnadore met in the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary. The Republican primary winner could not be verified, so all three are listed pending verification.
verified_ballot_note: Ballotpedia's HD 71 page lists Marie Masferrer (D) and Republicans Melton Little, Kristen Truong and Jordan Varnadore for the Aug. 18, 2026 primaries (https://ballotpedia.org/Florida_House_of_Representatives_District_71); Pulse of Manatee reported the fields set at qualifying (https://www.pulseofmanatee.com/p/florida-house-races-set-in-districts). Primary result not verified. Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

healthcare.summary: Says health care is a human right, supports expanding Medicaid and moving toward universal coverage.
healthcare.quote: I believe healthcare is a human right, support expanding Medicaid

housing.summary: Backs mixed-use and infill housing, stronger affordable-housing requirements on major developments and limits on corporate home purchases.

insurance.summary: Wants enforceable claim timelines, home-hardening grants and properly funded insurance oversight agencies.

energy.summary: Supports clean energy and a much bigger role for solar, and disclosure rules for large data centers.
energy.quote: support clean energy and a much bigger role for solar

immigration.summary: Supports fairer immigration pathways and separating civil immigration enforcement from ordinary policing.

abortion.summary: Opposes Florida's six-week restriction; says the decision belongs to patients and providers.

guns.summary: Supports universal background checks, waiting periods, safe storage, magazine and assault-weapon limits, and repealing permitless carry.
guns.quote: universal background checks, waiting periods, safe-storage requirements

education_choice.summary: Opposes expanding private-school vouchers with public dollars and wants accountability standards for charters.

elections.summary: Backs Fair Districts, restoring voting rights after sentences are completed, and closing the write-in loophole.

crime.summary: Supports civilian oversight of police, opposes police militarization and the death penalty, and wants trained responders rather than armed officers for many calls.

lgbtq.summary: Supports medically appropriate transgender health care, inclusive schools and a ban on conversion therapy.

marijuana.summary: Supports legalizing recreational cannabis alongside medical use.

environment.summary: Opposes fracking and expanded drilling, wants phosphate-mining oversight, wetland protection and stronger flood-resilience investment.

growth.summary: Opposes SB 180's limits on local land-use authority and wants growth that funds infrastructure first.
